digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting returns HTTP 429, but the DC transport does not honour Retry-After headers and a 429 propagates as a hard failure on first occurrence.

Retrying 429s through _with_connection_retry would reach all transport call sites including create_issue, reintroducing the duplicate-issue class since a 429 can arrive after the server began a write.
The 429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads via a per-call opt-in (rate_limit_retry) defaulting to OFF so future mutations cannot inherit retry by omission.
Retry-After should be honoured with up to 20% jitter applied first then clamped last to MAX_BACKOFF_S, reusing existing _errors helpers rather than a third implementation.
When the 429 retry cap is exhausted the code must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429), never leak the raw vendor JIRAError past the adapter boundary.
This parent ticket blocked plan review ten rounds while carrying two independent changes; splitting into a mechanical extraction (S1) and the 429 policy (S2) resolved it, both children now closed.
